name: Playbook
install:
command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh -sSf | sh
rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
npm ci
npm ci --prefix app
npm run wasm:build --prefix app

terminals.name: Playbook Pal
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Playbook Pal editor at http://localhost:5173
